caveats: This dataset is sourced from GADM (Global Administrative Areas) and has not been officially validated by the national authorities of São Tomé and Príncipe. An update from a national official source is pending. The administrative structure retains two provinces at Admin 1 for COD operational purposes, although provinces were formally abolished under the 1990 constitution. The island of Príncipe has held autonomous region status since 1995. Boundary alignments may differ from other reference datasets (e.g., OpenStreetMap, UN SALB) due to different data sources or update cycles.
license_title: Creative Commons Attribution for Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY-IGO)
methodology_other:
Dataset: Sourced from GADM (Global Administrative Areas), an open-source global administrative boundary database. The dataset was available prior to 2023, and no official updates have been received from the national authorities to date. The dataset structure was modified to reflect the current administrative hierarchy, with the former ADM2 level reclassified as ADM1 in accordance with the official ISO administrative reference.  
  
P-codes: P-codes generated and assigned by OCHA using OCHA's standard P-coding system.
name: cod-ab-stp
notes:
Sao Tome and Principe administrative level 0-1 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01.  
  
This dataset is structured into 1 level:  
- Admin 1: 7 Province  
  
  
Note: São Tomé and Príncipe comprises two provinces (São Tomé and Príncipe) at Admin 1, subdivided into 7 districts at Admin 2. Six districts are located on São Tomé island (Água Grande, Cantagalo, Caué, Lembá, Lobata, Mé-Zóchi) and one (Pagué) covers Príncipe island. The island of Príncipe has held autonomous region status since 1995.  
  
  
Dates associated with this dataset:  
- 01 June 2026: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness  
- 01 June 2026: valid for use by the humanitarian community  
- 01 June 2026: last edit to the dataset before publishing  
- 17 August 2020: boundaries created by the source  
  
Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx).  
  
Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
